title: Governed commit absorbs content it did not admit

preconditions: two writers share one canonical worktree and one index
writer-a resolves and admits a bundle of paths
writer-b mutates the index or the worktree before writer-a's commit executes
faultFingerprint.observation: the resulting commit tree is not equal to the bundle writer-a admitted

variants.summary: A path no admitted slice declared appears in the candidate tree.
An admitted path keeps its name but its content is replaced between admission and assembly.
variants.expectedInvariant: committed blob equals the sealed blob
variants.expectedOutcome: the sealed content is committed; the substitution never lands

variants.summary: No task-scoped bundle resolves and the executor would commit whatever the shared index holds.
variants.expectedInvariant: no governed commit without a sealed bundle

variants.summary: A shared-delivery plan is rejected after the commit object was written and the ref advanced.
variants.expectedInvariant: a rejected plan leaves HEAD unchanged
variants.expectedOutcome: no commit object is published and HEAD is byte-identical

variants.summary: Another lane advances HEAD between admission and ref update.
variants.expectedInvariant: ref update is compare-and-swap, never a force
variants.expectedOutcome: the other lane's commit survives and the delivery requeues

notes: Writer identities, paths and timestamps in this fixture are synthetic. The family reproduces from the shape of the interleaving, not from any recorded task, actor or date.
